question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Education is the process by i. to enlighten individuals and i. helps meet challenges which ii. which removes the darkness ii. and make the right choices (b) It is a mental and intellectual of ignorance to go ahead training iii. our minds, refine our iii. at a school, college or (c) The basic purpose of sensibility university. education is iv. which provides opportunities iv. and helps us distinguish (d) It is the business of education of growth and between right and wrong to ennoble v. our mind develops through v. at the same time develop (e) It is often compared to light formal learning our capacity to the limit
guide_solution: (a) Education is the process by which our mind develops through formal learning at a school, college or university. (b) It is a mental and intellectual training which provides opportunities of growth and helps meet challenges. (c) The basic purpose of education is to enlighten individuals and at the same time develop our capacity to the limit. (d) It is the business of education to ennoble our minds, refine our sensibility and make the right choices to go ahead. (e) It is often compared to light which removes the darkness of ignorance and helps us distinguish between right and wrong. → → → → → → →
